record.paper_title: 20 Open Questions About Deformations of Compactifiable Manifolds
record.original_question: Do there exist nontrivial deformations of W_1 = Tot(O_P1(-1) ⊕ O_P1(-1)), despite the fact that W_1 is formally rigid?

evidence.quote: Question 10. Decide whether there exist nontrivial deformations of W1. Note that [GKRS] proved that W1 is formally rigid.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $W_1 = \mathrm{Tot}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1) \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1))$ denote the total space of the rank-two holomorphic vector bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1) \oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1)$ over the complex projective line $\mathbb{P}^1$, viewed as a noncompact complex manifold of dimension three (the small resolution of the threefold node). It is known that $W_1$ is formally rigid, i.e. every deformation of $W_1$ over an Artinian local $\mathbb{C}$-algebra is trivial. By a deformation of $W_1$ we mean a proper-over-base or compactifiable family $\mathcal{W} \to \Delta$ over a (possibly nonreduced) complex base $\Delta$ with a marked central fiber isomorphic to $W_1$, and such a deformation is called nontrivial if it is not isomorphic, as a family near the central fiber, to the product family $W_1 \times \Delta$.

Question: Does there exist a nontrivial (necessarily non-formal) deformation of $W_1$?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this question was located. The question explicitly appears in a 2020 list of open problems about deformations of compactifiable manifolds, and the cited result that $W_1$ is formally rigid still stands; available literature on deformations of noncompact surfaces and threefolds (e.g. work on $\mathrm{Tot}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-k))$) does not address the existence of nontrivial non-formal deformations of $W_1$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: 20 open questions about deformations of compactifiable manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: List of open problems including the question on nontrivial deformations of W_1 despite formal rigidity.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an explicit open problem.

status_evidence.title: Classical deformations of noncompact surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies deformations of total spaces Tot(O_P1(-k)), without resolving the W_1 (resolved conifold) question.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature does not establish nontrivial deformations of W_1.
